text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Tensing up makes even my face go 
stiff...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I'm running in races too, I 
wonder if I should start taking better 
care of myself."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's not like I can just slap wax 
on 'em like a motorcycle...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gotta put on some loofah lotion just like 
Mom does. Scarlet, you've got the same 
kind, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Owing her a favor is the last thing I 
want, dammit...!

Vodka found herself troubled by rough 
skin...
